known_exceptions.integrations: Thin framework adapters (176 LOC / 5 files), each a shim over the public API. Tracked in SUBMODULE_STRUCTURE.md as debt, not a blocker; remove this exception when a real adapter is added.

SearchService.invariant: Server-tier WIRE ADAPTER. Returns pydantic models (SearchDocsOutput). Delegates all validation, concurrency bounding and result shaping to SearchCoordinator; reimplements none of it. Corrected in M05 (was wrongly recorded as _core.py / protocol-neutral).

DocsRetriever.invariant: a Protocol, not a base class; implementations are injected, never imported

HybridRetriever.invariant: Reciprocal Rank Fusion only; no score-space fusion across metrics

CorpusAnnoyRetriever.invariant: wires corpus+annoy behind the DocsRetriever Protocol; corpus is NOT imported at module scope

server_capabilities.invariant: reports what this build can do; never claims an unprobed capability

_server transport.invariant: the ONLY module permitted to import the MCP SDK

version guard.invariant: single wire-protocol rule; SDK absence degrades, never crashes import

SearchCoordinator.invariant: Tier-L (Python 3.8+, no pydantic, no MCP SDK). Validated, concurrency-bounded orchestration returning neutral dictionaries. This is the protocol-neutral service layer; integrations and the CLI self-test depend on it, never on _server.
